result.fix: Set `DefaultLimitNOFILE=65536` under `[Manager]` in a file in `/etc/systemd/system.conf.d/` and run `systemctl daemon-reexec`. A service can also set `LimitNOFILE=65536` in its unit, but this check does not read unit files and will not see it.
result.message: `DefaultLimitNOFILE=1024:524288` in `/etc/systemd/system.conf.d/10-defaults.conf` gives services an open files limit of 1024, need at least 65536.
notes: rdy's own open files limit is 1024 (soft) and 524288 (hard). That is a shell limit and does not apply to services.
